syllabus_extract: Introduction to communication system. Purpose, technical details and types of various communication systems.
specific_objectives: 21.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the basic theory of communication.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list

practical: Review of communication theory diagrams; Safety: None; Supervision: Instructor monitors PPT navigation
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of a communication system?
Define the basic theory of communication.
List the types of communication systems covered in this subject.

development.content:
Basic theory of communication
Purpose of communication systems
Signal transmission fundamentals
Modulation basics
Noise and interference

Types of communication systems
Analog vs Digital systems
Wireless communication principles
Ground vs Air communication
Satellite communication overview

Technical details of components
Frequency allocation basics
Antenna types and functions
Transmitter and receiver blocks
System integration overview

summary_questions: Explain the difference between analog and digital communication systems.
Describe the role of modulation in a communication system.
Identify the key components of a standard communication system.
